description: Election Commission - S. M. Don Nandana was Selected as the Member of the Dodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Dodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's absence from meetings. The content specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and the process for declaring a new elected member, making it clearly related to electoral processes and local government elections.
